observations: AGENTS.md was visibly injected by the real Web product. It stopped rather than silently choosing the ambiguous employment denominator, recommended women enrolled, and then used the frozen oracle definition consistently after the operator selected it.

The chat correctly reports Nalanda minus Purnia as 14.0 pp for completion and 19.0 pp for enrolled-cohort employment. It clearly says the aggregate file cannot establish why Purnia is lower or prove an intervention, and names additional evidence rather than inventing causes.

The requested CSV is unusually traceable: it includes the period, raw counts, units, gap direction, all three formulas, exact 14.0/19.0 primary comparisons, the separately labelled 11.7 pp funnel statistic, source file and synthetic-fixture identifier. Independent checking accepts it.

The final dependency-free page has working year controls, exact source rows, both primary formulas, no network dependencies, no browser errors and no document-level overflow at 390 px. It is visually plain, and wide tables require contained horizontal scrolling even on desktop; several right-side rate columns are not initially visible.

The page was not updated after the Purnia/Nalanda or causal follow-ups. Consequently, the final-page checker correctly flags the absent 14/19 pp callout and Purnia-specific caveat even though both are correct in chat and the CSV.

The harness asked two reasonable but additional questions: which employment denominator and which comparison table to export. The answers matched the oracle, but this means the run is not an unchanged four-message apples-to-apples result and cannot be pooled with the counted product comparison.

The four-turn session used 192,346 uncached input, 603,680 cache-read and 36,287 output tokens, with 542.518 seconds model time and 131.674 seconds tool time. The Web UI did not expose cost or reasoning effort.
evidence_notes: This is the closest tested deliverable alternative to Cline: actual published Web UI, multi-turn session, workspace-write sandbox, browser-reviewed page and downloadable artifact.

Its correctness gain over unguarded Web and guarded Cline is material, but the extra clarifications and page-follow-up omissions remain harness-product gaps to solve before a strict equivalence claim.
The archived session is compressed and complete; settings are redacted and no credential file is retained.
